fullDescription: A sophisticated, high-end portfolio design with a dark mode aesthetic, featuring a warm taupe and deep charcoal color palette. The style utilizes 'Clash Grotesk' for bold, geometric display typography and 'Satoshi' for refined body copy. Key features include a grain/noise texture overlay, custom dual-element cursor following, scroll-triggered text reveal animations, and a spinning SVG text badge. This design is optimized for creative professionals, graphic designers, art directors, and luxury branding agencies seeking a minimalist yet high-impact digital presence.
prompt:
## Resumo
A premium, minimalist portfolio landing page characterized by a dark #0d0d0d background, warm taupe #b7ab98 accents, and elegant motion design. It prioritizes white space, sharp geometric typography, and smooth, staggered scroll animations to create a professional and artistic atmosphere.

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual style with a deep charcoal background (#0d0d0d). Use 'Clash Grotesk' for headlines and 'Satoshi' for body text. Typography rules: Hero headlines at 140px (8vw) with -0.04em tracking; uppercase labels at 11px with 0.3em letter-spacing in #b7ab98; body text at 18px in #a0a0a0. Primary accent is taupe (#b7ab98), used for highlights and primary buttons. Secondary accent is coral (#eb5939). Implement a fixed noise texture overlay via a subtle SVG turbulence filter. All interactive elements should use a custom cursor: an 8px #b7ab98 dot and a 40px outlined ring that expands to 60px on hover. Borders should be subtle: 1px solid rgba(118,118,118,0.15). Transitions must follow cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) with 0.8s to 1.2s durations.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Design a fixed top navigation bar. Background transitions from transparent to #0d0d0d/95 with backdrop-blur-md on scroll. Logo on the left in Clash Grotesk; navigation links on the right using 12px Satoshi, uppercase, 0.12em letter-spacing. Include a custom underline hover effect where a 1px taupe line grows from 0% to 100% width.

### Hero Section
Implement a split-grid layout (8:4). The left side features a 4-line animated text reveal: Line 1 (11px taupe label), Line 2-4 (massive display headline). Use 'overflow: hidden' on containers to reveal text moving upward from 110% to 0%. The right side features a spinning SVG circular text ring ('Available for freelance') rotating at 20s per cycle, with a solid taupe circle and down-arrow icon in the center. Background should have a faint radial gradient glow (#b7ab98 at 3% opacity).

### Project Showcase
Create a 2-column project grid. Each card consists of a 4:3 aspect ratio image container. On hover, the image scales 1.05x and shifts from grayscale(20%) to full color. A centered overlay button with the text 'View Project' appears on hover. Below the image, include the project title in 22px Clash Grotesk and a muted category label.

### About and Statistics
A 12-column grid section. Left 4 columns: section title and subtitle. Right 8 columns: two paragraphs of 20px Satoshi text. Below the text, three statistics items (e.g., '12+ Years') using 40px Clash Grotesk numbers and 11px uppercase labels.

### Client List
A grid of client names or logos in a 3-column layout. Each item is separated by a horizontal border (rgba(118,118,118,0.15)). Text is 18px medium-weight Clash Grotesk, appearing sequentially with a staggered scroll animation.

### Testimonials
Two-column layout featuring large 26px italic Satoshi text for quotes. Include a client avatar (grayscale), name (15px), and role (12px) below the quote. Use wide gutters for an airy feel.

### Contact CTA
Centered layout with a massive headline (clamp(40px, 7vw, 110px)). Background features a large, soft radial taupe glow (3% opacity). Include two button styles: 'btn-primary' (solid taupe, black text, 12px uppercase) and 'btn-outline' (taupe border, taupe text, transparent background).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Rotating Text Badge — A circular SVG text element that rotates continuously.
Construct an SVG with a 200px viewBox. Define a circular path and use <textPath> to wrap text like 'AVAILABLE FOR FREELANCE •' twice. Set font to 13.5px Satoshi, weight 500, letter-spacing 3. Animate the rotation using a linear infinite keyframe animation (20s duration). Place a 64px taupe circle with a centered Lucide arrow icon in the middle.

### Interactive Cursor — Dual-layer cursor system with lag and blend effects.
Create two fixed elements: '.cursor-dot' (8x8px, solid #b7ab98, z-index 10000) and '.cursor-ring' (40x40px, 1px border #b7ab98, z-index 9999). Use 'mix-blend-mode: difference' for the dot. The ring must follow the mouse with a 0.15s delay/lerp. On hovering 'a' or 'button' elements, the ring should expand to 60px and change border color to #eb5939/60%.

style.description: The visual style is defined by its 'editorial dark' theme. It pairs the high-energy geometric sans-serif 'Clash Grotesk' with the balanced 'Satoshi'. The color strategy uses #b7ab98 (taupe) for emphasis and #eb5939 (coral) for micro-interactions. A global SVG noise texture at 3.5% opacity provides a tactile, film-like quality. Motion is fluid, utilizing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all transitions, creating a 'heavy' but responsive feel.
